status: Closed — taskflow and work-admission glob scope parity verified 2026-09-05
finding: During TASK-RFT-0047, the task scope contained packages/cli/src/commands/next/route-resolution/**/*.ts, but taskflow pre-close excluded the newly created child modules from the governed delivery bundle until each file was explicitly scope-added.
expectedBehavior: Taskflow commit-bundle projection should expand supported glob scope paths for new in-scope files, or emit an early deterministic warning that explicit child paths are required before implementation/commit.
evidenceOrRepro: The historical exclusion is no longer reproducible against the current source. `node --strip-types tests/cli/taskflow-scope-untracked-glob.test.ts` passed both matcher parity and inclusion of a newly created child file in the taskflow commit bundle on 2026-09-05. `node --strip-types tests/cli/work-admission-ticket-scope-glob-parity.test.ts` also exited 0.
followUp: Retain both glob-parity regressions. Reopen only if a new scope form diverges between taskflow bundle assembly and work-admission validation.
